item.title: Visit Busan Pass 2026: Prices (24H ₩55,000, Big 3 ₩45,000), What's Included & Where to Buy
item.description: The Visit Busan Pass (비짓부산패스) is a Busan sightseeing pass that only non-Korean visitors can buy and use. There are four kinds: the 24-hour pass at ₩55,000, the 48-hour pass at ₩85,000, Big 3 (you pick three attractions) at ₩45,000, and Big 5 (you pick five) at ₩65,000. Korean nationals can neither buy it nor use it, so if you are travelling with Korean friends or family, they will need their own tickets. Everything below is from the official Visit Busan Pass site, checked on November 14, 2026.

item.title: Haeundae Sky Capsule vs Beach Train: Price, Ride Time & Seats Compared (₩50,000 vs ₩20,000 for Two)
item.description: Same railway line, different height and different price. The Haeundae Blueline Park Sky Capsule (블루라인파크 스카이캡슐) is a capsule on an elevated rail that you share only with your own group (Mipo ↔ Cheongsapo, 2 km, about 30 minutes one way, from ₩50,000 per capsule). The Beach Train (해변열차) runs on the tracks underneath and goes 4.8 km, all the way to Songjeong (₩10,000 per person for a single ride, no reserved seats). For two people going from Mipo to Cheongsapo, that’s ₩50,000 by capsule and ₩20,000 by train. (Checked on the official Blueline Park website, November 13, 2026)

item.title: Gimhae Airport to Busan Station, Seomyeon & Haeundae: Light Rail + Subway from ₩1,600, Limousine Bus Times, Taxi Fares
item.description: From Gimhae International Airport (김해국제공항), the standard way into Busan is the light rail to Sasang Station (사상역), then subway Line 2. With a transit card it takes about 26 minutes and ₩1,600 to Seomyeon (서면), about 39 minutes and ₩1,800 to Busan Station (부산역), and about 56 minutes and ₩1,800 to Haeundae (해운대). With a lot of luggage the limousine bus is easier (₩6,000 to Seomyeon, ₩9,500 to Haeundae), but the last one leaves in the 21:00 hour, so you will miss it if you land on a late flight. The numbers below are from the Busan-Gimhae Light Rail, Busan Transportation Corporation, and Korea Airports Corporation’s Gimhae Airport pages, checked on November 13, 2026.

item.title: Haeundae Sky Capsule Walk-In Tickets: Can You Buy on the Day? What to Do When It's Sold Out & the Tuesday 07:00 Online Release
item.description: Yes, you can. There just aren’t many, so don’t count on it. Haeundae Blueline Park (해운대블루라인파크) sells a small number of on-site tickets at the counter, first come, first served, separate from the online stock. The official notice says they “can sell out early”. If your travel date is fixed, book online first and treat the counter as a backup. One thing works the other way round: discounted fares, such as the senior and Busan resident rates, are sold only at the counter. (Checked on the official website, November 12, 2026)

item.title: Busan Weather in November & December 2026: Average Temps (11.9°C → 5.8°C), What to Wear, Sunset at 17:11 & How It Compares to Seoul
item.description: November in Busan is late autumn, and December is early winter: cold, but not Seoul cold. Going by the Korea Meteorological Administration (기상청, KMA) climate normals, which are 1991 to 2020 averages, Busan’s mean temperature is 11.9°C in November and 5.8°C in December. That is 4 to 6°C warmer than Seoul on the same basis (7.5°C and 0.2°C). It rains little (50.4mm in November, 33.8mm in December) and clear days are common, but the sea wind is stronger than in Seoul. The sun also sets early, as early as 17:11 in early December. So pack layers and a windproof outer layer; they will do more for you than one thick coat. The numbers come from the KMA Open MET Data Portal and the Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute (한국천문연구원, KASI), checked on November 11, 2026.

item.title: Haeundae Sky Capsule 2026: Prices (₩50,000 for 2), How to Book Before It Sells Out, Winter Last Entry 17:30 & Sunset Times
item.description: Book the Sky Capsule in advance. Tickets go on sale on the official website every Tuesday at 07:00 (KST) for the week starting four weeks later (Monday to Sunday), and only a small number of same-day tickets are sold at the counter. The price is per capsule, not per person: ₩50,000 for 2, ₩55,000 for 3, ₩60,000 for 4 (one way, Mipo ↔ Cheongsapo, about 30 minutes). From November to February the last entry slot is 17:30–18:00, and Busan’s sunset in late November and December is between 17:11 and 17:21, so the 16:30 and 17:00 slots overlap with it. Everything below comes from the Haeundae Blueline Park official site (bluelinepark.com), the Busan Tourism Organization (visitbusan.net) and the Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute’s monthly sun tables. I checked it all on November 10, 2026.

item.title: Busan Station to Haeundae (2026): Subway in 46 Min for ₩1,800, Express Bus 1003, Taxi Fares & Last Trains
item.description: The subway from Busan Station (부산역) to Haeundae Station (해운대역) takes 46 minutes and costs ₩1,800 with a transit card. You ride Line 1, change once at Seomyeon Station (서면역), and finish on Line 2. If you would rather stay in one seat, express bus 1003 stops at both Busan Station and the Haeundae Beach bus stop for ₩2,100. The details below come from Busan Transportation Corporation’s route search, fare table and timetables, Busan city’s fare pages, and the official Busan tourism site (visitbusan.net). I checked them on November 9, 2026.

item.title: Gamcheon Culture Village, Busan (2026 Guide): Hours, Free Entry, Toseong Station Exit 6 Bus & Parking
item.description: Gamcheon Culture Village (감천문화마을) has no entry fee and is open every day of the year. The Busan Tourism Organization lists visiting hours as 09:00–18:00 from March to October and 09:00–17:00 from November to February, and the village information center is open 09:00–18:00. The usual way in is Line 1 to Toseong Station, Exit 6, then a village bus up the hill. Everything below comes from the village’s official website (gamcheon.or.kr) and the official Busan tourism site, checked on November 8, 2026.

item.title: Christmas Village Busan 2026 (Nov 26 – Dec 25): Opening Days, Tickets from ₩5,900 & Which Subway Exit
item.description: Christmas Village Busan 2026 (크리스마스 빌리지 부산) runs from Thursday, November 26 to Friday, December 25, 2026 on the outdoor plaza of the Busan Cinema Center (영화의전당), 120 Suyeonggangbyeon-daero, Haeundae-gu. It is not open every day. It opens on 21 days, mostly Thursday to Sunday, and this year it has switched to paid, pre-booked tickets. Online tickets start at ₩5,900 on weekdays and cost ₩14,900 on December 24 and 25. Everything below comes from the official ticket page on YES24 (the sole seller) and the Busan Cinema Center website, checked on November 7, 2026.

item.title: Haeundae Light Festival 2026 (Nov 28 – Jan 10): Lighting Ceremony Time, Subway Exit & What to See
item.description: The 13th Haeundae Light Festival (해운대빛축제) runs from Saturday, November 28, 2026 to Sunday, January 10, 2027 at Haeundae Beach (해운대해수욕장) and Haeundae Square on Gunam-ro (구남로). The lighting ceremony is on November 28 at 18:00 on the sand at Haeundae Beach. This year’s theme is “Deep Dive Haeundae.” Everything below comes from the Haeundae-gu district office (Korean only), checked on November 6, 2026.

item.title: Don't Rely on Google Maps Alone in Korea: Naver Map & KakaoMap Guide (2026)
item.description: A map app is one of the first things to set up before a trip to Korea. In most countries Google Maps is all you need, but in Korea it’s much easier with Naver Map or KakaoMap installed as well. (As of November 5, 2026)

item.title: Busan Fireworks Festival 2026 (Nov 7): Show Times, Which Subway Exit to Use & Ticket Deadline
item.description: The 21st Busan Fireworks Festival takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, across Gwangalli Beach, Igidae and Dongbaekseom Island. The main show, the Busan Multi Fireworks Show, runs 19:25–19:55. Everything below is based on the official website (busanfireworks.com), checked on November 5, 2026.

item.title: About
item.description: I live in Busan and write practical guides to the city’s festivals, travel and everyday life. Dates and prices are based on official announcements, with sources linked. When details change, posts are updated and the update date is shown.
